## Problem

`dss scan --no-docker` on the **host** walks into other filesystems mounted under the scan roots: here 44 read-only overlay mounts `/tmp/containerd-mount*` (container image mounts left by containerd). It reports files inside them as host items:

```
safe        found  python-bytecode  ×44  235.8 MiB   all under /tmp/containerd-mount*/…
aggressive  found  node-modules     ×44  436.6 MiB   e.g. /tmp/containerd-mount2616588863/tmp/bunx-1001-node-gyp@latest/node_modules
```

**Every** "safe, found" item on that host was inside such a mount. The real host items (apt, npm and node-gyp caches) were correctly blocked as busy. Walking the 44 image trees also made the scan take 232 s (`scanner projects 122891ms`, `scanner versions 103174ms`). These mounts are read-only, so a clean would have failed with EROFS. A read-write mount of a container rootfs (Docker/containerd/podman, a bind mount of another disk) would have been modified.

```
$ mount | grep containerd-mount | head -1
overlay on /tmp/containerd-mount2616588863 type overlay (ro,relatime,lowerdir=6844/fs:6843/fs:…)
```

## Reproduction (expected, not run as-is)

```
mkdir -p /tmp/m && mount --bind / /tmp/m        # or any overlay of a container image
npx -y disk-space-saviour@0.13.1 scan --no-docker --verbose
```
Items appear under `/tmp/m/…`.

## Suggested fix

- Do not cross mount points while searching (`st_dev` check, like `find -xdev`), except for roots the user listed explicitly.
- Always skip container runtime mounts (`/tmp/containerd-mount*`, `/var/lib/docker`, `/var/lib/containerd`, `/run/containerd`, overlay mounts from `/proc/self/mountinfo`). Container contents are only handled through the Docker path.
- Skip read-only filesystems as "not removable" instead of offering their files.

---

We need to download all logs and data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), in which we will reconstruct timeline/sequence of events, list of each and all requirements from the issue, find root causes of the each problem, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

If there is not enough data to find actual root cause, add debug output and verbose mode if not present, that will allow us to find root cause on next iteration.

If issue related to any other repository/project, where we can report issues on GitHub, please do so. Each issue must contain reproducible examples, workarounds and suggestions for fix the issue in code. Also double check to fully apply requirements to entire codebase, so if we have issue in multiple places, it should be fixed in all them.

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until it is each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: Host scan crosses mount points into /tmp/containerd-mount* container image mounts and offers their files as safe host items
